items.title: Runner
items.reason: A sustained organ-delivery pursuit gives this 98-minute action-comedy a recurring physical-action backbone, with road chases, multiple fights, shootouts and a hospital confrontation. The Guardian's whole-film review describes jam-packed action sequences, a car chase and a six-against-one fight; Cinema.de highlights Ritchson's forceful physical fighting, while Rotten Tomatoes characterizes the film as fast, over-the-top crowd-pleasing action. Strengths include a capable lead, vehicle pursuit and buddy chemistry. Limitations include formulaic cartel opponents, uneven tone, questionable effects and an overextended finale. Density is judged from whole-film review evidence rather than pace alone; military background does not make the story military-focused.
